name: notepad-code
description: Minimalist black & white notebook and page organizer for VS Code, accessible across all workspaces.

chatParticipants.name: notepad
chatParticipants.description: Manage, search, and organize your notebooks and notes.

languageModelTools.name: notepad_list_notebooks
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists all user notebooks and pages in Notepad Code with IDs, titles, and summaries.

languageModelTools.name: notepad_read_page
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Reads the title, full content, and word/character counts of a specific note page in Notepad Code.

notebookId.description: ID of the notebook containing the page.

pageId.description: ID of the page to read.

languageModelTools.name: notepad_search_notes
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Searches for notes matching a text query across all notebooks and pages in Notepad Code.

languageModelTools.name: notepad_create_notebook
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Creates a new notebook in Notepad Code.

title.description: The title of the new notebook.

languageModelTools.name: notepad_create_page
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Creates a new note page with a title and content in NORMAL PLAIN TEXT format (NOT markdown syntax like #, ##, **, ```).

notebookId.description: ID of the notebook to create the page in.

title.description: The title of the note page (plain text).

content.description: Content of the note in NORMAL PLAIN TEXT format (do not use markdown formatting like #, **, ```).

languageModelTools.name: notepad_update_page
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Updates the title and/or content of an existing note page in NORMAL PLAIN TEXT format (NOT markdown).

notebookId.description: ID of the notebook containing the page.

pageId.description: ID of the page to update.

title.description: New title for the note (optional, plain text).

content.description: New content for the note in NORMAL PLAIN TEXT format (optional, no markdown).

languageModelTools.name: notepad_rename_notebook
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Renames an existing notebook in Notepad Code.

notebookId.description: ID of the notebook to rename.

languageModelTools.name: notepad_delete_page
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Deletes a specific note page from a notebook in Notepad Code. Prompts user for confirmation to prevent accidental data loss.

notebookId.description: ID of the notebook containing the page.

pageId.description: ID of the page to delete.

languageModelTools.name: notepad_delete_notebook
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Deletes an entire notebook and all its pages from Notepad Code. Prompts user for confirmation to prevent accidental data loss.

notebookId.description: ID of the notebook to delete.

languageModelTools.name: notepad_export_notes
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Exports all notebooks and notes from Notepad Code as a JSON string backup.

languageModelTools.name: notepad_import_notes
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Imports notebooks and notes from a JSON string into Notepad Code. Prompts user for confirmation to prevent accidental data overwrite.

jsonData.description: The JSON backup string to import.
